title: Content Library Still — listening on the go

location.series: Cox Brand Collection — Lindsay Little / Periscope

slide_intent: Show a device within an understandable activity so viewers can relate connectivity to their own routines.
strategic_value: The headphones and phone can extend Cox’s visual story beyond the home.
demonstration: A man wearing green headphones looks at his phone while standing beside a pale brick wall.
practical_value: Choose wardrobe and background contrast that keep the device and activity easy to read.
